launch_slurm_job: submit a SLURM job using submitit AutoExecutor with configurable nodes, GPUs, and array jobs
launch_local_job: launch a local distributed job using torch elastic launch or single process mode
run_slurm_spmd_program: execute a SPMD program on SLURM with checkpointing, seed setting, and distributed backend setup
map_job_config_to_dist_config: convert a JobConfig into a distributed training config dict with world size and backend settings
remove_runner_state_from_submission: decouple a submitted job from runner state to prevent stale checkpoint resubmission on node failure
